title: Gamification và style-template sharing
scope_items: Target 1 (Per-user progress): Creator level progression (levels 1-50, milestones L1=0, L5=100, L10=500, L20=2,000, L50=25,000 XP), daily active streaks with UTC midnight cutoff, milestone rewards (7-day=10 credits, 30-day=50 credits, 90-day=200 credits), downtime grace period extension (EC-GAM-001), retroactive achievement backfill (EC-GAM-002), and zero-participant challenge cancellation after 24h (EC-GAM-003).

Target 2 (Reward event replay once): Idempotent reward deposit engine ensuring duplicate event delivery or webhook replays deposit credits and XP exactly once, tracking event IDs in tenant-isolated table gamification_reward_events with admin scope and RLS.

Target 3 (Licensed template install clones tenant-owned pack): Installing a style_workflow recipe clones approved style parameters into the destination workspace, creating a tenant-owned continuity style pack and inactive draft workflow, with immutable install audit recording recipe ID and template version without source-tenant internal IDs.

Target 4 (No private source media in shared style template): Style template governance validator strictly enforces schema_version >= 1, requires parametric style settings and license notice, and rejects private media URLs (file://, localhost, private S3), raw camera footage, face/voice biometric embeddings, and secret API credentials.
Connect-Go RPC & Proto Surface: Full 11-RPC surface for GamificationService with RBAC checks, fail-closed authorization, and 4-target codegen (Go, Connect-Go, TypeScript/shared-types, Dart/mobile).

SvelteKit Web Client & Flutter Mobile: Screen W079 (Web Gamification Dashboard) and Screen M038 (Mobile Gamification Screen) implementing level cards, streak flame trackers, quest progress indicators, 3x3 badge gallery, and interactive governance & replay test consoles.
verified_sub_slices: Go Gamification Engine & Concurrency Tests: apps/api/internal/gamification/gamification_test.go passes all 8 test suites with -race (TestAcceptanceTarget1_PerUserProgress, TestAcceptanceTarget2_RewardEventReplayOnce, TestLevelProgressionThresholds, TestStreakProgressionAndMilestoneRewards, TestChallengeLifecycleAndZeroParticipantCancellation, TestRetroactiveAchievementBackfill, TestConcurrentGamificationActivityRaceSafety, TestGamificationConnectRPCRoundtrip).

Go Recipe Style Template Extension Tests: apps/api/internal/recipe/style_template_test.go passes with -race (TestAcceptanceTarget3_LicensedTemplateInstallClonesTenantOwnedPack, TestAcceptanceTarget4_NoPrivateSourceMediaInSharedStyleTemplate [9 subtests], TestTakedownStopsNewInstalls, TestStyleRecipePermissionDenial), alongside existing 8 recipe tests.

DB Migration & RBAC Exposure: infra/migrations/00044_p8_06_gamification_and_style_templates.sql verified; apps/api/internal/migrate passes all 44 migrations; apps/api/internal/rbac passes all 4 exposure tests with 0 future-phase RPCs.

Web Vitest, Svelte Check & Production Build: apps/web/src/lib/gamification/gamification.test.ts passes all 18 tests; svelte-check reports 0 errors and 0 warnings; vite build succeeds cleanly with @sveltejs/adapter-node.
Mobile Flutter Tests & Analyzer: apps/mobile/test/gamification_test.dart passes all 13 tests including widget test and protobuf serialization; flutter analyze reports 0 issues.
Proto 4-Target Generation & Zero-Drift: tooling/proto-gen.sh verify reports PROTO_4_TARGETS_PASS mode=verify with zero code drift across Go, Connect-Go, TypeScript, and Dart.
Documentation Invariants: tooling/check_docs.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tooling/tests report PASS.

external_gates.description: Gamification engine, level progression, streak calculator, style template governance, and replay idempotency operate deterministically in Go backend, SvelteKit, and Flutter. Live social platform engagement triggers require connector webhooks in staging.
